caption:
309 apartments are under construction on East Cesar Chavez.

The project at 2915 E. Cesar Chavez St. is going up on the former Eastside Lumber & Decking site near North Pleasant Valley Road. Groundbreak Austin reported on Nov. 16 that construction is underway, with completion expected in late 2027. The state project filing lists 309 apartments.

Why it matters: this is future rental supply for East Austin’s 78702 ZIP code. The expected construction completion date is a useful marker for tracking when renters might have more options nearby. It doesn’t establish when leases will open or what rents will be.

Sources: Groundbreak Austin, Nov. 16, 2026; Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation project filing.
